text:
Munster’s median asking rent stands at 13.92 €/m² in June 2026, up 5.4 % year‑on‑year and 30.9 % over the past five years, placing the city 11th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 25th‑percentile rent is 11.82 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 16.22 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 835 € per month.

The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.1 % and listings staying on the market for an average of 21 days; 36 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 17.2 %, and asking rents command a 60 % premium over existing rents of 8.71 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 14.54 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 14.03 €/m² and 14.93 €/m², implying a further 4.5 % rise.
